failure_condition: Error text is visible but is not programmatically associated with the invalid field.
interaction_steps: Submit or inspect the invalid form.
Compare the error text with the field's accessible description.
expected_outcome: The association is recorded as an implementation difference; criterion conformance remains not testable from association alone.
manual_verification_method: Determine whether the detected error is identified and described in text; separately assess usability of association.
dom_testability: Can inspect aria-describedby and the referenced error element.
accessibility_tree_testability: May expose description relationships, but this alone does not establish a 3.3.1 failure.
limitations: Missing aria-describedby alone does not prove a WCAG 3.3.1 failure when visible explanatory text exists.
